data.title: OrderFlow (E-Commerce Backend Engine)
data.subtitle: Production-Oriented Spring Boot Backend Engine
data.content: A high-performance Java 21 & Spring Boot 3.x backend implementing JWT auth with refresh token rotation, pessimistic row-level DB locking for concurrency control, Redis cache-aside invalidation, API idempotency, and Razorpay HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification.
engineeringHighlights: JWT Auth with Refresh Token Rotation
PostgreSQL Pessimistic DB Locking for Inventory Control
Redis Cache-Aside Strategy with Eviction TTL
Flyway Schema Migrations & Testcontainers Integration Tests

data.title: ShoppingAdda (E-Commerce Platform)
data.subtitle: Full-Stack Web Store with Authentication & Payments
data.content: Full-stack e-commerce web application featuring user authentication with OAuth Google Sign-In, interactive product catalog, shopping cart management, state persistence, chatbot integration, and payment checkout flow.

data.title: YouTube Clone Platform
data.subtitle: REST API-Driven Video Streaming Application
data.content: Frontend video application built with React, demonstrating component-driven architecture, REST API integration, live search query debouncing, responsive video player controls, and category feed filtering.

data.title: Animate-On-Scroll Web Product
data.subtitle: Interactive Landing Experience with Scroll Animations
data.content: Interactive web landing showcase focused on high-performance scroll triggers, Framer Motion viewport reveals, clean typography hierarchy, and smooth layout composition.

data.title: Interactive Quiz Web Application
data.subtitle: API-Driven Real-Time Quiz Engine
data.content: Real-time interactive quiz application using vanilla Web APIs, dynamic DOM manipulation, score state tracking, timed progress handlers, and asynchronous trivia endpoint fetching.

data.title: TravelEase Booking Interface
data.subtitle: Modular React Travel & Tour Exploration Platform
data.content: Modular travel destination platform designed for exploring tour packages, filtering locations dynamically, managing booking details, and displaying custom modal UI views.

data.title: Todos List Task Manager
data.subtitle: Lightweight Task Management & LocalStorage Persistence App
data.content: Lightweight task management web application built with React and Tailwind CSS featuring local browser storage persistence, status filters, task creation, and instant deletion.
engineeringHighlights: Clean State CRUD Handlers in React
